ocr.notes: quotation marks around "confident of victory in the coming mill" and "go in" dropped

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen came into the city from his training quarters in excellent condition and confident of beating Charley Gallagher in their fight the following Tuesday.

metadata.notes: masthead reads THE MISSOURI REPUBLICAN--ST. LOUIS, AUGUST 14, 1869

facts.fact: Allen was training outside St. Louis for his fight with Charley Gallagher, set for Tuesday, August 17, 1869, and was said to be in excellent condition and confident

notes: Second paragraph concerns a postponed presentation of colors to Gallagher at his saloon; not an Allen fact.
